providers.title: Disjoint ORs
providers.scope: For the OR of m disjoint copies of P: s_0 is at most m s_0(P), s_1 is at most s_1(P), and if P(0) = 0 the block sensitivity at zero is at least m bs(P, 0).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A quadratic example (Rubinstein)
providers.scope: The OR of k copies of the exact-pair function on 2k bits has sensitivity 2k and block sensitivity at least k^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Composition
providers.scope: s(f o g) <= s(f) s(g); if g(0) = 0, then bs(f o g, 0) >= bs(f, 0) bs(g, 0).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Powering
providers.scope: A function with f(0) = 0, s(f) <= A and bs(f, 0) >= B > A^2 > 1 gives, by repeated composition, functions with bs >= s^alpha, alpha = log B / log A > 2, and bs at zero tending to infinity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Labels on a tournament
providers.scope: The edges of the regular tournament on 2M^2 + 1 rows can be labelled from [ceil(sqrt M)] so that no 16 rows admit positions m_j matching every label inside them.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Clauses and nesting
providers.scope: The conditions of a clause concern distinct children, so one flip changes at most one of them; the predicates of each level are nested.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Blocks at zero
providers.scope: At level l all predicates vanish at zero and have M k^l common disjoint sensitive blocks of size L r^l.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Level zero
providers.scope: The Hamming-ball predicates have S_0 <= L, S_1 <= LM and no joint sensitivity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sensitivity recurrences
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Growth of the profiles
providers.scope: If M >= 9^(d+1), then S_(l,b) <= 2 L M^(l+b) for all levels l <= d.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Block sensitivity versus sensitivity squared (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every C > 0 there is a nonconstant Boolean function with bs(f) > C s(f)^2; for every d >= 1 one with bs(f)/s(f)^2 >= 2^d / (4 (d+2)^2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A power separation
providers.scope: There are alpha > 2 and nonconstant Boolean functions F_m with bs(F_m, 0) >= s(F_m)^alpha and bs(F_m, 0) tending to infinity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
